name: Gately API
description:
REST API for managing members, forms, analytics, campaigns, and more.

**Base URL:** `https://api.usegately.com/api/v1`

**Authentication:** Pass your API key as `Authorization: Bearer gately_sk_live_xxxxx`. Get keys from Dashboard → Settings → API Keys.

> **Deprecated endpoints:** `/lms/*`, `/ecommerce/*`, `/shop/*`, and `/help/*` are deprecated and will be removed in a future version. Do not use them in new integrations.
